evaluations.rationale: No incompatible permissions, behaviors, constraints, states, or rules with another story.
Inviting via URL is compatible with the later limit of up to 15 estimators.
Starting a round by entering an item does not impose a rule inconsistent with other item-management stories.
Viewing all session items is compatible with other item and round stories.
Selecting an item for estimation or re-estimation is compatible with related item and round stories.
Adding an item to the estimation list does not conflict with other item-management rules.
Editing an item does not impose a rule inconsistent with other item stories.
Deleting an item does not conflict with other item-management stories.

This conflicts with PP-033's requirement that estimates be shown only after all estimators have submitted, and with PP-034/PP-041's expectation that estimates are not revealed until the draw completes.
Accepting the average estimate is compatible with other estimate-finalization stories.
Auto-filling the estimate when all cards match does not conflict with other estimate-finalization stories.
Manually entering the agreed-upon estimate is compatible with accepting or auto-filling an estimate.
Re-estimating an earlier story is compatible with selecting and managing items.
Importing stories from a spreadsheet is an additional capability and does not conflict with other stories.
Copy/pasting stories is compatible with importing and manually adding items.
Browsing previous games does not conflict with transcript or deletion stories.
Viewing a transcript is compatible with export and game-browsing stories.
Exporting as HTML does not conflict with CSV export or transcript viewing.
Exporting as CSV is compatible with HTML export and transcript viewing.
Deleting a game does not impose a rule inconsistent with browsing or exporting games; it only affects deleted games.
Account creation is compatible with login and account-management stories.
Login is compatible with account creation and management stories.
Changing account details does not conflict with other account stories.
Deleting an account is compatible with account lifecycle stories; it does not impose ongoing access requirements.
Local timezone display does not conflict with other stories.
Password reminder by email does not conflict with account stories.
Choosing between estimation scales does not conflict with card-ordering or estimation stories.
Limiting estimators to 15 is a constraint compatible with inviting estimators via URL.
Joining a game by entering a name is compatible with game creation and invitation stories.
Seeing the current item is compatible with other estimation-session stories.
Seeing all items to estimate is compatible with current-item and item-list stories.
Seeing that a specific estimator has submitted an estimate does not reveal the estimate value and does not conflict with later reveal stories.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with PP-009's permission to show estimates immediately even before all estimators have submitted.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with PP-009's early reveal, which can show estimates before the final reveal and truncate the change window.
Viewing prior estimates is compatible with estimate-visibility stories because it does not require early reveal of current estimates.
Seeing who gave which estimates during the current round can occur after the reveal and does not conflict with reveal-timing stories.
Starting a timer is compatible with the timer reset story and other discussion stories.
Automatic timer reset after estimates does not conflict with manually starting the timer.
Scrolling back through prior rounds is compatible with current-round estimate stories.
Keeping card order stable across draws does not conflict with scale selection or other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Conflicts with PP-009's ability to reveal estimates before the draw has completed.

Unicode support does not conflict with other stories.

Nice error pages do not conflict with other stories.
